title: Existence of a proper binary factor
statement: For a natural number $\ell$ and a vector $m\in(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^\ell$, the Boolean test returns true exactly when there are vectors $a,b\in(\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^\ell$, each different from the all-one coefficient vector, whose binary convolution coefficients agree with the monic coefficients specified by $m$ in every degree from $0$ through $2\ell$.
hypotheses_covered: $m$ is a vector of length $\ell$ over $\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z}$
